subject: Request: runway/top-up for postponed demo + rollout reschedule (Fidelis)
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@fidelis.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integrations delay — asking for runway & demo reschedule

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from our side — our engineering team hit an unexpected blocker integrating our HIPAA proxy with Redwood's VPC connector. The work is taking longer than the estimate and the demo we had for next week will need to move.

We still want to proceed (Fidelis is committed) but we need two things to keep momentum on our side: a) a short extension on the sandbox/runway so we don’t lose dev access while we finish the connector, and b) a small credit top-up to cover the extended trial usage while we validate the end-to-end flow. Without this we risk pushing the POC past our internal acceptance window.

Can you advise if Redwood can extend our trial by ~3 weeks and add a modest credit (we estimate ~$2k) so we can pick up where we left off? I can share the engineering notes and a refreshed demo window once we confirm dates.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Director, Product Integrations
Fidelis Health

Attachment: demo-scope-v2.pdf (scope update)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@fidelis.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integrations delay — asking for runway & demo reschedule

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the scope doc. Sorry to hear about the connector snag.

We want to keep fidelity on the POC — we can provision a short runway and I’ll request a credit top-up with our deal ops team. To move quickly, can you confirm: 1) the new target demo week (date range), 2) whether the proxy needs any special network config we should pre-authorize, and 3) whether you want the credits applied as sandbox dollars or a one-time promo code for the trial account.

Marissa — looping you in to approve a temporary runway extension and the requested credit. Recommend we cap at 3 weeks and $2k unless ops asks for another form. Alex, can you advise on approval flow and any compliance checklist we need to satisfy for the VPC work?

Next step: Elena, if you send the revised demo week I’ll escalate internally and try to lock this down within today.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Karthik / Alex — forwarding Fidelis' ask. TL;DR: 3-week runway extension, ~$2k sandbox credit. Fidelis is a mid-sized regional health customer in our pipeline (DL-9837) and this POC is time-boxed by their Q2 acceptance.

Approval ask: can we grant a single 3-week free extension + $2k sandbox credit (applied to the trial project) to keep the momentum? If so I’ll notify the customer and attach a short MOU/credit-grant form for signature.

Notes:
- Compliance: their team mentioned a HIPAA proxy; ops may want to review the VPC connector change.
- Billing: mark as non-recoupable promo.

If you approve I’ll prepare a one-page credit form and a quick amendment to the MOU.

— Marissa

Marissa / Karthik — approved.

I cleared this with Deal Ops and Product Ops: we can grant a 3-week sandbox extension and a $2,000 credit (applied to their trial project). Condition: Fidelis signs the attached credit-grant form and acknowledges the extension window and that this is a one-time goodwill grant tied to DL-9837.

I will:
- Provision the sandbox extension today (will notify infra for account flag).
- Create the promo credit and apply to their trial account once the signed form is uploaded.
- Loop in Security for a quick read on the VPC connector note (no red flags so far but they asked to review the config doc).

I’ve attached the credit-grant-form.pdf and a draft MOU (fidelis-mop-signed.pdf — placeholder until they sign). Marissa, please send the form to Elena and I’ll handle the provisioning.

— Alex Martinez
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com

Subject: Credit grant & next steps (Fidelis)

Elena — good news, we approved a one-time 3-week extension and a $2,000 sandbox credit for the Fidelis trial. Please find the credit-grant-form.pdf attached.

Next steps:
1) Please sign and return the attached credit-grant-form (PDF).
2) Confirm the new preferred demo week (we have availability Apr 28-May 4, or May 5-11).
3) If you can, share any short network config notes so Security can speed the review.

Once we receive the signed form Alex will provision the credit and I’ll confirm the extension window. We’ll mark the grant as non-recoupable and tied to DL-9837.

Thanks — and sorry again for the engineering hiccup; we’re glad to keep the POC moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
